k:捉.mnemonic: Fingers (扌) shoot out and close around the leg (足) of the runaway chicken just as it jumps the fence. Seize (catch, capture).

k:肢.mnemonic: Break one and it needs a splint to support (支) it for a month (月): that is an arm or a leg. Limb (arms & legs).
k:肢.hint: A splint for four long weeks.

k:赴.mnemonic: The divining rod (卜) dips and points, so you run (走) off in that direction without stopping to argue. Proceed (get, become, tend).

k:猟.mnemonic: The hound (犭) has one task (用): chase down the pheasant so that it ends up on the table (几). Its eyes sparkle (⺌) as it runs. Game-hunting (shooting, game, bag).

k:累.mnemonic: Sheaves from the rice field (田) are tied with thread (糸) and stacked one on top of another, the pile rising all season. Accumulate (involvement, trouble, tie up).

k:傑.mnemonic: A leader (亻) so admired that people climb to the top of a tree (木), their dancing legs (舛) kicking with joy, just to catch sight of him. Greatness (excellence).
k:傑.hint: Fans kicking for joy in the treetop.

k:伎.mnemonic: The leader (亻) balances upside down on one hand with no support (支) at all, and the crowd gasps at the feat. Deed (skill, ability, talent).

k:暁.mnemonic: Early (早), before anyone else is up, twenty (廾) pairs of legs (儿) are already running along the ridge as the first light breaks behind them. Daybreak (dawn, in the event).
k:暁.hint: Runners on the ridge at first light.

k:蜂.mnemonic: An insect (虫) so loaded with pollen that it has to trudge (夂) through the air back to the hive, humming with the effort. Bee (wasp, hornet).

k:漠.mnemonic: At dusk (暮) a tsunami (氵) of sand and haze rolls over the plain and blurs the horizon: no edges, only wide empty space. Vague (obscure, desert, wide).
k:漠.hint: Hazy horizon over the evening sands.

k:漸.mnemonic: The tsunami (氵) did not come as a wave. The tide crept up the scaffold one step at a time until the beheading (斬) had to be called off. Steadily (gradually advancing, finally, barely).
k:漸.hint: Tide creeping up, step by step.

k:鍋.mnemonic: A metal vessel as bright as gold (金) hangs over the fire, and the whole family sits facing (向) it with chopsticks ready. Pot (pan, kettle).
k:鍋.hint: Family circled round the fire, chopsticks out.

k:疎.mnemonic: He builds a hut in a tree (木) at the far end of Asia (亜) and tells every visitor to stop (止) at the bottom. Soon nobody comes at all. Alienate (rough, neglect, shun).

k:瞳.mnemonic: Look closely into someone's eye (目) and a tiny juvenile (童) looks back at you from the dark centre: your own small reflection. Pupil (of eye).
k:瞳.hint: Tiny figure in the dark centre.

k:俵.mnemonic: The leader (亻) slaps the surface (表) of a straw sack to hear whether it is packed full of rice. Bag (bale, sack).
k:俵.hint: Slapping a straw sack of rice.

k:窟.mnemonic: A hole (穴) running so deep into the mountain (山) that explorers plant a flag (尸) at the mouth to find their way back out. Cavern.
k:窟.hint: Flag planted at the dark mouth.

k:遍.mnemonic: A salesman with a heavy tome (冊) under his arm walks every path (辶) and knocks at every door (戸) in the land. Everywhere (times, widely, generally).

k:怠.mnemonic: The statue on the pedestal (台) is covered in moss and pigeons. The keeper's heart (心) was never in the job. Neglect (laziness).

k:蹴.mnemonic: Concerning (就) the ball: swing the leg (足) back, curl the foot like a fishhook (乙), and let fly. Kick.

k:硝.mnemonic: A white crust that grows on cellar stone (石) over a month (月). Scrape it off into gunpowder and it burns with a sparkle (⺌). Nitrate (saltpeter).
k:硝.hint: White cellar crust that fizzes alight.

k:硫.mnemonic: A yellow stone (石) sits on a rock pedestal (台) beside the hot river (川) at the volcano, smelling of rotten eggs. Sulphur.
k:硫.hint: Yellow, egg-smelling rock by a volcano.

k:喉.mnemonic: The leader (亻) is about to speak and you know (知) it, because first he coughs twice to clear the pipe his voice comes up through. Throat (voice).

k:昆.mnemonic: One day (日) the children stand back to back to compare (比) heights against grandfather's marks on the doorframe: his line, carrying on. Descendants (elder brother, insect).

k:零.mnemonic: The general orders (令) the rain (雨) to stop, and it obeys so completely that not one drop falls. The gauge reads nothing. Zero (spill, overflow, nothing).
k:零.hint: Rain gauge reading nothing at all.

k:粧.mnemonic: Under the canopy (广) of her dressing tent, the actress powders her face with rice (米) flour and colours her cheeks with red soil (土). Cosmetics (adorn).
k:粧.hint: Rice powder and red clay cheeks.

k:股.mnemonic: The warrior sits and rests his weapon (殳) across the top of his leg, where the texture (肌) is all thick muscle. Thigh (crotch).
k:股.hint: Spear resting across the upper leg.

k:雰.mnemonic: Rain (雨) broken into such fine parts (分) that it hangs in the air as mist, and the whole street feels hushed and strange. Atmosphere (fog).

k:殻.mnemonic: A samurai (士) balances a walnut on his forehead (冖) and taps it with his weapon (殳): the hard outer case splits and falls away. Husk (nut shell).
k:殻.hint: Walnut cracked on a warrior's brow.

k:胎.mnemonic: A pedestal (台) on which a new life rests and grows, month (月) after month, for nine of them. Womb (uterus).

k:柿.mnemonic: In autumn every tree (木) in the city (市) market hangs with orange fruit, each one wearing a little green hood (冂) of leaf on top. Persimmon.
k:柿.hint: Orange fruit in little green hoods.
